title: US Revokes Iran Oil Waiver After Tanker Attacks, Launches New Strikes on 80+ Targets
summary: The US struck over 80 Iranian sites (air defense, IRGC boats, coastal radar) and revoked Iran's oil sales license after two tankers — Qatari LNG tanker Al Rekayat and Saudi supertanker Wedyan — were struck in the Strait of Hormuz on July 7. Brent crude settled +3% at $74.16/bbl; after-hours extended to $76.04 (+5.6%) when sanctions were reimposed. WTI rose to $72.25 (+5.4%).
why: 最重大地缘冲击：霍尔木兹海峡局势升级+伊朗石油制裁重启，推高油价与全球通胀预期，进一步压缩降息空间；高估值成长股承压，油服板块受益；能源通胀加剧令美联储更难偏鸽

title: Samsung Q2 2026: Operating Profit Surges 19x YoY — Yet Triggers Global Memory Stock Selloff
summary: Samsung Q2 preliminary operating profit reached ~89.4 trillion won (+19x YoY), revenue roughly doubled — yet Samsung stock fell ~6-7%, SK Hynix ~6%, Micron/SanDisk/Western Digital dropped ~7% on July 7. Markets are worried about AI capex sustainability, HBM margin durability, and potential DRAM/HBM oversupply risk in H2 2026.
why: 直接影响持仓美光(MU)、闪迪(SNDK)、SK海力士：存储超周期估值受严峻考验；Samsung抛售后是重新评估 sell put 行权价与保证金缓冲的关键时刻

title: Fed Holds at 3.63%; July 28-29 FOMC Expected Unchanged; Futures Price Rate Path to 3.8-4% by Year-End
summary: The Federal Reserve maintained the effective fed funds rate at 3.63% after its June 2026 decision, with inflation still above 2%. The July 28-29 FOMC meeting is expected to hold rates unchanged. Futures markets price a path rising to ~3.8% by October and approaching 4% by year-end 2026 — a higher-for-longer stance.
why: 高利率持续压制成长股估值折现；利率路径上修风险令期权 sell put 权利金吸引力下降；7月29日FOMC是最近关键观察点

title: Gold Falls $49 on Iran-Hormuz Strike — Inflation Fear Trumps Safe-Haven Demand
summary: Gold fell from $4,165 to an intraday low of $4,116 (-1.1%) on July 7 as tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz sparked oil inflation fears rather than safe-haven demand. A Hormuz-driven oil spike stokes inflation, keeps the Fed hawkish, elevates real yields, and pressures gold — the market's counter-intuitive but logical reaction in the 2026 higher-for-longer environment.
why: 黄金避险属性弱化背后是能源通胀加剧Fed鹰派逻辑：实际利率走高是黄金的持续逆风；持有老铺黄金(6181.HK)者需关注金价走势对业绩影响

title: 7月8日A股：美伊局势推高油服板块，上证指数承压；市场整体调整
summary: 7月8日A股市场整体承压，上证指数受压调整，美伊开战推高国际油价令油服概念板块活跃，成为为数不多的反弹主线。沪深北三所新版交易规则6日施行后市场进入适应期，成交量有所收窄，科技主线小幅反弹，房地产等板块继续承压。
why: A股短期受伊朗地缘因素影响有限，但油价上升可能传导至下游通胀，并影响货币政策预期；油服、能源类板块的阶段性交易机会

title: Alibaba 9988.HK: Court Grants Lobbying Reprieve on Pentagon Blacklist; $600M DOJ Settlement Reached
summary: US District Judge Eumi K. Lee ordered the Pentagon to suspend treating Alibaba as a 'Chinese military company' for lobbying-ban purposes (1260H designation added June 8), pending court review. Separately, Alibaba and AUS Merchant Services agreed to pay $600M total to resolve DOJ illegal pharmaceutical sales allegations — Alibaba's share: $125M criminal penalty + $200M forfeiture.
why: 两大关键法律风险阶段性化解：法院保护令暂停Pentagon名单效力；DOJ和解金额$600M对阿里财务影响有限；股价有望修复前期压制，是重新评估持仓的关键窗口

title: 腾讯正式发布混元3.0（Hy3）：295B参数开源MoE模型，全面集成微信/元宝/WorkBuddy（7月6日）
summary: 腾讯7月6日发布Hy3（混元3.0），295B总参数MoE架构，激活参数21B，支持256K上下文，幻觉率从12.5%降至5.4%，Apache 2.0可商用开源。集成至微信AI助手、元宝App、WorkBuddy，日均token消费量月增20倍。中金维持跑赢评级，目标价HK$666。同日回购46.5万股耗资HK$2.048亿。
why: AI落地超预期且有规模证明（token消费20倍增），是估值重估重要催化；开源策略有助构建生态；回购信号积极；0700.HK sell put 策略溢价有望受益
source: 财新全球 / 腾讯官方

title: Circle CRCL: 140-Firm Consortium (Visa, Mastercard, Google, BlackRock) Announces Open USD to Challenge USDC; Stock Fell 16%
summary: On June 30, 2026, Open Standard — a 140-company consortium including Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Stripe, BlackRock, Coinbase, Google, and BNY — announced Open USD stablecoin: fully reserved, zero mint/redeem fees, distributes nearly all reserve earnings to member firms rather than a single issuer. Circle (CRCL) fell 16% to $63.85 on the day. USDC commands $78B in circulation; Circle generates 95.5% of H1 2026 revenue from reserve interest.
why: USDC商业模式（利息收入95%）面临结构性威胁；140家巨头联合体量压倒性，Circle持仓者需重估竞争格局；高隐含波动率下 sell put 需保守行权价

title: Tesla TSLA: Q2 Deliveries 480,126 Units (+25% YoY); Robotaxi Expands to Miami; Optimus Production Starts July; Q2 Earnings July 22
summary: Tesla reported Q2 2026 global deliveries of 480,126 vehicles (+25% YoY). On July 3, fully unsupervised Robotaxi service (no safety driver) expanded to western Miami-Dade — now covering Austin, Dallas, Houston, and Miami. Optimus humanoid robot production begins July 2026. Musk targets Robotaxi in a dozen+ states by year-end. Q2 2026 financial results due July 22.
why: Q2交付超预期+Robotaxi多城扩张+Optimus量产：三重催化强化成长叙事；7月22日财报前隐含波动率升高，是 sell put 关注窗口
source: Motley Fool / Basenor / Globe and Mail

title: 泡泡玛特 Labubu 亮相FIFA 2026世界杯开幕式，成首个登上世界杯官方MV的艺术玩具IP
summary: 6月12日，两只泡泡玛特Labubu巨型公仔作为特别嘉宾出现在2026 FIFA世界杯开幕式球场，并首登世界杯官方主题MV。此前3月29日官宣与FIFA合作推出The Monsters x FIFA限定系列（盲盒、毛绒、配件），在北美、墨西哥举办地同步销售。
why: Labubu全球品牌破圈至史上最高规格体育IP；世界杯期间持续全球曝光，有望刺激海外销售与品牌认知，是9992.HK估值重估正面催化

title: 美团开源 LongCat-2.0：1.6T参数MoE，行业首次在5万卡国产ASIC集群完成训练，SWE-Bench超GPT-5.5
summary: 美团6月30日正式开源 LongCat-2.0（1.6T总参数MoE，激活约48B，支持1M上下文），MIT许可证，完全使用国产ASIC算力（5万卡）完成全量训练推理，全球首例。此前以别名Owl Alpha霸榜OpenRouter全球开发者榜两个月。SWE-Bench Pro得分59.5，超GPT-5.5的58.6。
why: 美团AI技术实力超预期且有国产算力突破，有助重估3690.HK科技溢价；开源MIT许可证加速商业化落地；国产算力突破具政策信号价值

title: Nvidia NVDA: Blackwell Ultra GA for Agentic AI (20x More Agents/Megawatt vs Hopper); Data Center Revenue +92% YoY
summary: Nvidia's Blackwell Ultra (GB300 NVL72: 72 GPUs + 36 Grace CPUs, rack-scale) is now generally available for agentic AI workloads, delivering 20x more agents per megawatt vs Hopper. Anthropic Claude on Microsoft Azure running on Nvidia GB300 Blackwell Ultra is now GA. Recent quarterly results: revenue $81.6B (+85% YoY), data center $75.2B (+92% YoY). Jensen Huang: 'Agentic AI has arrived, doing productive work.'
why: AI基础设施需求持续超预期，Nvidia护城河加深；Blackwell Ultra扩大对HBM4的长期需求，利好SK海力士/美光持仓；NVDA自身期权策略基本面背景持续改善

title: Micron MU: Record Q3 FY2026 Revenue $41.46B (+346% YoY); HBM4 Ramping 2x Pace; 16 Take-or-Pay SCAs Signed
summary: Micron Q3 FY2026 (reported June 24): revenue $41.46B (+346% YoY, +74% QoQ), non-GAAP gross margin 84.9%, diluted EPS $25.11. HBM4 shipments for Nvidia Vera Rubin began March 2026, ramping at ~2x the pace of HBM3E, yield ahead of expectations. Signed 16 Strategic Customer Agreements (SCAs) with take-or-pay terms, $22B+ in commitments covering up to 50% of future revenue.
why: 历史性业绩叠加SCAs锁定长期需求；Samsung earnings引发的抛售是重新评估 sell put 进场点的机会，SCAs锁定基本面下行保护

title: SK Hynix 2026 HBM Outlook: Leads Market at 50-55% Share; HBM3E Covers ~2/3 of 2026 Shipments; HBM4 Ramping
summary: SK Hynix expects HBM to fuel the AI memory supercycle through 2026, commanding 50-55% market share. HBM3E is expected to account for approximately two-thirds of total 2026 HBM shipments; HBM4 gradually increases share in H2. SK Hynix has been building new packaging plants and ramping fabs to meet demand. Stock fell ~6% on July 7 amid Samsung earnings-triggered memory selloff.
why: HBM市场领导地位稳固，但Samsung财报引发的抛售拖累7709.HK；HBM定价韧性和客户需求是 sell put 策略核心观察指标

title: SanDisk SNDK: Stock Falls ~14% in Memory Selloff; Up ~487% YTD; BiCS10 10th-Gen NAND Production Begins With Kioxia
summary: SanDisk (SNDK) fell approximately 14% in a single session on July 6, pulling back from all-time highs — still up ~487% year-to-date. Selloff trigger was Meta announcing it would sell spare AI compute capacity externally, easing AI compute shortage fears. Simultaneously, SanDisk began BiCS10 (10th-gen NAND) production with Kioxia in Japan, sampling 1Tb BiCS10 TLC chips for AI data-center storage.
why: 持仓闪迪者：大幅回调中检查 covered call 期权情况；BiCS10量产是长期利好，短期抛售属情绪驱动，基本面无恶化——是 sell put 评估机会

title: Intel INTC: 18A-P Production Starts; Profitable Yields Delayed to Late 2026/2027; Q1 Foundry External Rev Only $174M; Q2 Earnings July 23
summary: Intel began production of its 18A-P process node (9% higher performance or 18% lower power vs 18A), but profitable yields are reportedly not expected until late 2026 or early 2027. Q1 2026 Intel Foundry generated only $174M in external customer revenue with large operating losses. HSBC raised PT to $200 citing long-term potential. Q2 2026 earnings due July 23.
why: Foundry良率延迟是英特尔最大不确定因素；Q2财报（7月23日）是转折点判断关键；期权：高隐含波动率提供 sell put 机会，但良率风险需设足够安全边距

title: Palantir PLTR: Nvidia Sovereign AI Partnership + US Army NGC2 Core Data Layer Win; Q1 US Commercial Revenue +133% YoY; Stock +14% Pre-Holiday
summary: Palantir launched a new engine to deploy NVIDIA Nemotron open models in sovereign/air-gapped US government environments. The US Army selected Palantir Foundry as the core data layer for its top-priority NGC2 modernization program. D.A. Davidson upgraded to Buy with $175 target. Q1 2026 US commercial revenue grew 133% YoY. PLTR rallied ~14% before July 4, 2026.
why: 政府+商业双轮驱动加速，AI平台定位强化；高估值意味着高隐含波动率，sell put 时需留足安全边距以应对政策风险

title: 小米 YU7 上市6个月交付超15万辆，为SU7同期2.3倍；2026年全年目标55万辆
summary: 雷军宣布，小米 YU7 上市6个月累计交付超15万辆，相当于SU7同期交付量的2.3倍，超出市场预期。小米2026年全年汽车交付目标设定为55万辆（同比约+34%，2025年实际约41万辆）。港股7月8日盘中小米（1810.HK）涨幅居恒指成分股前列。
why: YU7销量爆发强化小米汽车成长叙事，是1810.HK sell put策略的重要正面催化；汽车业务持续改善为持仓提供基本面支撑

title: Alphabet GOOGL: Gemini App Surpasses 750 Million Monthly Active Users; 2026 AI Capex Plan Reaches $175-185B
summary: Alphabet announced the Gemini AI app surpassed 750 million monthly active users. Alphabet plans to invest $175-185B in 2026 capex (vs $91.4B in 2025), funded by operating cash flow, debt, and equity issuances — the largest single-year AI infrastructure investment commitment in history. Annual revenue first crossed $400B in 2025.
why: 谷歌AI商业化全面提速；大规模资本支出是AI基础设施长期需求强信号，间接利好英伟达/SK海力士等持仓；GOOGL自身 sell put 基本面背景改善
